title: Day 741: Federal Security Cabinet Reports Concordia Arms Seizure, Culiacán Chemical Lab Dismantlement, Guasave Fugitive Arrest
detail: Mexico's federal security cabinet reported a cluster of counter-cartel operations across Sinaloa for August 3, 2026. In Concordia, military personnel seized four long guns, 19 magazines, 573 cartridges, five ballistic vests, and ten ballistic plates. In Culiacán, the Army located and disabled two synthetic-drug concentration sites, seizing approximately 2,000 liters of precursor chemicals — an estimated 38 million pesos in damage to organized crime finances. Naval forces operating in the Villamoros Peninsula area found and disabled 1,735 kilograms of additional chemical substances (approximately 3.17 million pesos in losses). In Escuinapa, Navy personnel recovered 106 cartridges and a vehicle while freeing one kidnapping victim near Ojo de Agua de Palmillas. In Guasave, coordinated agencies arrested a fugitive wanted by Chiapas state authorities on femicide charges. The report reflects the routine cadence of the ongoing federal interdiction campaign against Chapitos and La Mayiza infrastructure across the state.

sources.name: Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana (SSPC)
